name: cache-cost
title_zh: 按 provider 价目实测 tokens
tagline_zh: 你以为缓存命中 80% 就省 80%？错。它从 usage 事件聚合真实 cache_hit/miss。
tagline_en: 80% cache hit ≠ 80% savings. It sums real cache_hit/miss tokens from usage events, applies your provider's price.
desc_en: LLM 前缀缓存成本核算技能——需要对比不同预算窗口（大/小）成本、估算每 run 成本、或决策缓存配置时使用。核心方法：从 request.usage 事件聚合真实 tokens_in/cache_hit/cache_miss → 按**当前 provider 价目**核算 → 对比方案。目标：用实测数据做成本决策，避免"命中率百分比≠成本"的直觉陷阱。常用工具: execute_command/search_records。
why_zh: 把「命中率」这个误导指标换成「每 run 实付成本」——按 provider 当前价目逐项核算。
why_en: Replaces misleading hit-rate with per-run real cost — priced by your provider's current rates, so cache config decisions stop.
limit_zh: 只认 request.usage 事件里的 tokens_in/cache_hit/cache_miss 字段。
limit_en: Only works with request.usage events containing tokens_in/cache_hit/cache_miss; providers without these logs are out. It prices, not optimizes, your.
title_en: Real token cost by provider, not hit-rate math
